title: The shell loads the admin bar and search overlay on demand and the shell budget tightens to the measured size
detail:
AdminBar (42 KB with body), SearchOverlay and DockBar are static shell imports. The shell budget is 1400 KB against 957 KB measured, so regressions of 45% pass. Lazy-load, then set the budget near the new reading.

2026-10-26: search overlay is lazy (#3931). Measured on Vercel builds: shell 1,131 KB / 25 chunks before, 1,030 KB / 24 after (front door 332 -> 329 KB). Budget lowered 1,400 -> 1,100 KB. Row stays open: its probe regex dynamic\([^)]*(admin-bar|search-overlay) cannot match any dynamic(() => import(...)) call, because the arrow's own parentheses end the [^)]* run. The probe needs correcting before this row can close. The admin bar stays eager (it listens for open-admin-bar on mount).

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
